mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tech_english_sentence_pattern WHERE normalized_pattern = #{normalizedPattern} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tech_english_sentence_pattern_corpus (sentence_pattern_id, corpus_id, createby, updateby, deleted) VALUES (#{sentencePatternId}, #{corpusId}, #{userId}, #{userId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deleted = 0, updateby = #{userId}, updatetime = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
